duration.description: A length. Default up to the end of the clip.

feather.description: Soft edge of the region in pixels, 0 to 200. Default 0.

height.description: Height of the region, a fraction of the picture.

new_id.description: The id of the blur item.

new_track_id.description: The id of the track when one is made.

radius.description: Blur radius in pixels at project resolution, 1.5% of the shorter side to 100. Default 4%.

start.description: Absolute start of the blur, inside the clip. Default the start of the clip.

track_id.description: A visual track above the clip. Default a Blur track above it, made if there is none.

width.description: Width of the region, a fraction of the picture.

x.description: Left edge of the region, a fraction of the picture.

y.description: Top edge of the region, a fraction of the picture.
